record.question: Which Catheter site has the highest risk of infection?
record.explanation: Answer B: Femoral vein. Among the listed sites, femoral access has greater infection risk than internal-jugular access in adults; subclavian is generally avoided in dialysis patients due to stenosis risk. “Catheter site” needs patient/access context. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/dialysis-safety/about/index.html; https://www.cdc.gov/infection-control/hcp/intravascular-catheter-related-infections/summary-recommendations.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
